# reviewd

> reviewd is an agent-native code review control plane: independent AI pre-review,
> line-anchored human comments, immutable rounds and deterministic feedback to the coding
> agent that opened the change. Self-hosted; native DSH integration; CLI and HTTP for other
> harnesses.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/AKhasa9ov/reviewd

## Constraints

- No MCP server is shipped.
- Native adapters exist for DSH only; Claude Code, Codex, pi and custom agents use the CLI
  or HTTP API.
- The CLI has no `comments resolve` subcommand; use `review_resolve_comment` or
  `POST /api/reviews/:id/comments/:cid/resolve`.
- The daemon is single-tenant: one shared token, no user accounts.
- The 0.1.x npm packages are published under `@sir_yami/*`.
- Never put the daemon token in a model prompt or repository file.
